name: Rise of Olympus

features.name: God powers
features.description: Zeus, Hades and Poseidon each have a different random grid modifier.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Choose a god and a multiplier that grows with each cascade.

review:
Rise of Olympus mixes cascading grid wins with three god-specific modifiers. It's an older take on the Greek mythology theme than Gates of Olympus and plays quite differently, with more frequent mid-sized feature triggers.

Zeus turns symbols into wilds, Hades removes a symbol type, and Poseidon transforms a set of symbols into one type. These modifiers can trigger randomly after a non-winning spin, so the base game rarely feels empty. In free spins you choose a god and the matching modifier plus a multiplier that grows with each cascade. It's a good alternative for players who like Greek mythology but find Gates of Olympus too volatile, with a top RTP of 96.5% when casinos use the highest version.
